comments:
Commentary based on another commentary by someone referred to as "Jo bo" (= Atiśa (ID:3745), or Jo bo 'bum (ID:5611)?) composed in "bsam yangs" (maybe for bSam yas?). 

The author refers to the interpretation by 'Brom ston (ID:6284) and other Tibetan scholars (referred to as “dags po” and “khyung po”). 

The text contains a number of Sanskrit expressions transcribed in Tibetan (e.g., ’bu dha, bo de sa dha, lo ga).

This work may correspond to the "phar phyin" listed in the Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11502: ar byang chub ye shes kyi phar phyin), see (ID:6536).
